description: This file defines the API schema for the DOCSIS WAN Interface components and related operations, including retrieval, modification, reset, and event types within a network management system.

methods.name: Interfaces.Physical.Network.WAN.DOCSIS.Get
methods.description: Retrieves the status and configuration parameters of the DOCSIS WAN Interface.

methods.name: Interfaces.Physical.Network.WAN.DOCSIS.ResetStatistics
methods.description: Resets the statistics counters of the DOCSIS WAN Interface.

methods.name: Interfaces.Physical.Network.WAN.DOCSIS.Set
methods.description: Modifies the status and configuration parameters of the DOCSIS WAN Interface.
